issues.description:
`Task::current()` currently always returns `Some(CurrentTask { })`, which contradicts its own documentation (bootstrap should return `None`) and removes the prior linkage to the runtime notion of “current task”. This will break callers that rely on `None` in bootstrap/interrupt contexts and makes `CurrentTask` unusable for accessing per-task state.

This issue also appears on line 103 of the same file.
issues.rationale: Read full Task diff and head lines86-95. Newly re-enabled current() unconditionally returns Some despite explicit None-on-bootstrap contract. Base implementation was commented out: do NOT describe as change to previously active runtime code. Valid finding is restoring a behaviorally different stub under the original documented API.
